tools.name: analysis
tools.description: Static understanding-layer analysis (no Godot needed). action=signal_map lists all signal connections in the project (.tscn [connection] declarations + .gd connect/emit references, sources labelled separately); action=impact_check assesses blast radius before a change — for a signal, lists all connectors/emitters/listeners; for a script, the scenes and nodes that reference it; for a scene, its connections/scripts/where it is instanced. Known blind spots: runtime-built signal names and autoload-to-autoload connections are invisible.

action.description: signal_map = full signal connection map; impact_check = blast radius of a change

project_path.description: Project path

signal.description: Signal name filter (exact match for signal_map; impact_check needs one of three)

scene.description: signal_map: scene path substring filter (e.g. scenes/ui)

tools.name: android
tools.description: Android deploy tool. list_devices: adb device list. get_preset_info: read the Android preset from export_presets.cfg. deploy: export APK + adb install + launch (optional).

project_path.description: Godot project directory

lines.description: logcat: number of lines to dump (default 100)

tools.name: animation
tools.description: Query, control and edit animations. Query: list_players, get_info, get_details, get_keyframes. Playback: play, stop, seek, blend. Edit: create, delete, update_props, add_track, remove_track, add_keyframe, remove_keyframe, update_keyframe. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

root_path.description: Node path to start searching from (list_players)

node_path.description: AnimationPlayer node path (required for everything except list_players)

update.description: Update the node immediately after seeking (seek)

tools.name: animation_track
tools.description: Animation track and keyframe operations. Tracks: add_track, remove_track. Keyframes: add_keyframe, remove_keyframe, update_keyframe. Curves: set_curve. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

insert_at.description: Track insert position, -1 = end (optional for add_track)

time.description: Keyframe time in seconds (required for add_keyframe)

tools.name: animtree
tools.description: Query, control and edit AnimationTree: create the node, add states and transitions, set blend parameters, play a state, edit state properties. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

action.description: Operation: animtree_create creates an AnimationTree node; animtree_add_state adds a state; animtree_add_transition adds a transition; animtree_set_blend sets a blend parameter; animtree_play plays a state; animtree_state_edit edits state properties

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

value.description: Parameter value (float for blends, {x,y} for blend spaces)

sub_action.description: Sub-action of animtree_state_edit: set_position sets a state's position (needs state_name + position); set_blend sets a blend parameter (needs parameter_name + value)

tools.name: asset
tools.description: Parametric 3D shape generation (11 shapes) + path arrays + batch + undo + save as prefab. create/path/batch/undo/save persist through the editor (visible in the viewport, undoable); list_shapes/list_materials return static data.

project_path.description: Godot project directory

material.description: Preset name / PBR dict (color(hex),alpha,emissive,metallic,roughness) / res://.tres / null

parent.description: Parent node path (absolute /Root/X or relative X/Y)

path_node.description: path: Path3D node path in the scene (exclusive with path)

spacing.description: path discrete: equal spacing (exclusive with count)

count.description: path discrete: equal count (exclusive with spacing)

align_vertices.description: path continuous+spacing: align to polyline segment boundaries

node_path.description: save: node path of the subtree to save

tools.name: audio
tools.description: Audio operations. play: play (AudioStreamPlayer/2D/3D). stop: stop. set_param: set a parameter (volume_db/pitch_scale/bus). query: playback state. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

stream_path.description: play: audio resource path (res://...); omit to play the configured stream

value.description: set_param: parameter value (number for volume_db/pitch_scale, string for bus)

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Operation audit log (G3). action=get_log reads {project}/.godot/mcp_audit.jsonl as stats and replay (operation counts / risk highlights / recent entries / time range); action=suggest_rollback gives an honest rollback suggestion for one entry (created files can be deleted / project.godot before_values / everything else via Git). Write/destructive operations are logged automatically by the audit after-middleware (changed_files are project-relative, PII guarded).

action.description: get_log = stats and replay; suggest_rollback = rollback suggestion for one entry

project_path.description: Project path (default: auto-resolved by resolveProjectPath)

limit.description: get_log: take the last N entries (default all)

since.description: get_log: ISO time filter (only entries after it)

tools.name: blender
tools.description: Procedural modeling in Blender. action=execute_bpy: the AI writes a bpy snippet, it runs headless and the result is exported as glb into res://. (⚠️ bpy is full Python: the threat surface is host RCE, an order of magnitude above the execute_gdscript sandbox. bpy code goes through a sandbox scan (known dangerous API patterns, list not published so the boundary can't be probed) + a double opt-in bypass, same philosophy as execute_gdscript; the glb export target is additionally constrained by resolveWithinRoot. Local single-user trust model.)

project_path.description: Godot project directory

export_path.description: glb export path relative to the project root, optional res:// prefix (e.g. assets/models/rock.glb)

code.description: bpy modeling snippet (no import/export needed, godot-mcp wraps it)

tools.name: cpp
tools.description: GDExtension (C++) scaffolding. scaffold_gdextension: generates a complete, buildable godot-cpp GDExtension project under project_path (src/Class.cpp/.h + register_types + SConstruct + .gdextension + .gitignore + README); no network, no compiling; follows the official godot-cpp example.

project_path.description: Root directory of the generated GDExtension project (must be inside ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS)

parent_class.description: Parent class (whitelist of Godot built-in classes, default Node)

godot_version.description: Godot version (4.4–4.7; picks the godot-cpp clone ref, SConstruct api_version and .gdextension compatibility_minimum; 4.6/4.7 use godot-cpp master (v10) + api_version (no godot-4.x-stable ref), 4.4/4.5 use the godot-4.x-stable branch. Default 4.7)

force.description: Overwrite if the target exists and is not empty (default false)

tools.name: csv_to_resources
tools.description: CSV → Resource batch generation. Reads a CSV (class_path points at a GDScript Resource class), names files by filename_column, writes .tres files into output_dir. CSV rows are read with GDScript FileAccess.get_csv_line (never spliced into script source, injection-safe). output_dir goes through the resolveWithinRoot sandbox (TS pre-check); filename whitelist (GDScript regex + rejects .. segments).

project_path.description: Path to Godot project directory

class_path.description: GDScript Resource class path (e.g. res://item.gd); each CSV row instantiates this class

output_dir.description: Output directory (inside the project, res:// or relative, sandbox-checked)

filename_column.description: CSV column used as the output file name

csv_path.description: CSV file path (inside the project; or csv_content)

timeout.description: GDScript execution timeout in seconds (raise for big CSVs, default 60)

tools.name: debug
tools.description: Interactive debugger — breakpoint management + Phase 2/3 debugger integration (editor-only). Phase 1: set/clear/list breakpoint (via the CodeEdit gutter; scripts open automatically since CMP-14). Phase 2: stack_trace (call stack + variables) / inspect_frame (switch frame + read variables) / evaluate (REPL in the breakpoint context). Phase 3: step (into/over) / continue (run to the next breakpoint) / pause (request a break) / reload_scripts (hot reload). ⚠️ editor-only: needs GODOT_MCP_MODE=editor + the Godot plugin installed + the game running (F5). ⚠️ Phase 2/3 need the game paused at a breakpoint (step/inspect/evaluate) or running (pause/reload).

action.description: Action type: set_breakpoint | clear_breakpoint | list_breakpoints | stack_trace | inspect_frame | evaluate | step | continue | pause | reload_scripts

path.description: set/clear/list: res:// path of the .gd script (opened automatically since CMP-14, no need to activate the tab first)

frame_index.description: inspect_frame: stack frame index to inspect (0 = innermost, default 0)

expression.description: evaluate: GDScript expression to evaluate in the breakpoint context

mode.description: step: step mode (into = step into, over = step over; note: Godot's wire protocol has no step out)

paths.description: reload_scripts: array of res:// script paths to hot-reload

all_vars.description: stack_trace/inspect_frame: true = return every variable (truncated to 100 by default)

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Query Godot class documentation: get_class_info, search_classes, find_method, get_inheritance.

class_name.description: Godot class name (required for get_class_info, find_method, get_inheritance)

method_name.description: Method name to find (required for find_method)

tools.name: editor
tools.description: Editor real-time operations: sync_start (start scene tree listening), sync_stop (stop listening), get_scene_tree (get current snapshot). Requires editor mode with plugin connection.

project_path.description: Godot project directory path

tools.name: engine
tools.description: Live ClassDB introspection + node method calls (editor-only): query the classes/methods/properties/signals/enums the running engine actually has, or call an instance method on a node in the editor scene tree. class_info: full structure of one class (properties/methods/signals/enums/inheritance); default no_inherit=true shows only its own members. search: substring match on class names (returns a {name, parent} list, max 100). Then use class_info for the members. get_inheritance: the class inheritance chain (from the class up to Object). call_method: call an instance method on a node in the editor scene tree (like node.call). args are coerced to the declared parameter types ([1,2,3] becomes a Vector3). The deny-list blocks dangerous methods by default (free/queue_free/set_script/call/emit_signal etc.); env GODOT_MCP_EDITOR_CALL_DENYLIST_OVERRIDE adds to it (union with the default list, can only add; an explicit empty string lifts it). Calls cannot be undone (the response says undoable=false). ⚠️ Fills the gap in the docs tool: docs is a static 4.7 snapshot (no third-party addons/custom classes/4.6/4.8 differences), engine is the running engine's real ClassDB. ⚠️ editor-only: headless mode returns EDITOR_ONLY (ClassDB is blocked in the sandbox, so it goes through the editor layer).

action.description: Action type: class_info | search | get_inheritance | call_method

class.description: class_info/get_inheritance: class name (e.g. Node, Sprite2D, RigidBody3D, or a class registered by a third-party addon)

query.description: search: substring match on class names (case-insensitive)

no_inherit.description: class_info: true = own members only (default; walking the inheritance chain buries new APIs); false = merge the inheritance chain

node_path.description: call_method: target node path (e.g. "root/Player", "Player/Sprite2D", relative to the editor scene tree root)

method.description: call_method: method to call (unknown methods get did-you-mean suggestions; the deny-list blocks free/queue_free/set_script/call and other dangerous methods by default)

args.description: call_method: positional argument array (coerced to the declared parameter types, e.g. [1,2,3] for a Vector3). At most 8 arguments

tools.name: game
tools.description: Game bridge. Install/remove: game_bridge_install, game_bridge_uninstall. P2-1 override injection: install_override/uninstall_override (inject any debug script into the project's autoloads before launching the game, e.g. log hooks / state snapshots). Query: game_query (ping, get_tree, find_nodes, get_node_properties, get_performance, get_viewport_info, take_screenshot). Write: game_write (set_node_property, call_method). Input: game_input (send_key, send_mouse_click, send_mouse_move, send_text, send_touch, send_drag, send_input_sequence — frame-timed input timeline). Wait: game_wait (wait_for_node, wait_for_property). P2-4 deterministic playtest: game_playtest (playtest.seed locks RNG, playtest.fixed_delta locks the step, playtest.step advances frames, playtest.snapshot/restore state snapshots). G1 control layer: playtest.freeze (freezes the game loop, the bridge still answers), playtest.unfreeze, playtest.step_until (stops when conditions hold / frames run out / wall timeout; structured conditions {path,property,op,value}[] ANDed). Monitoring: monitor_start/stop/poll (property timeline sampling). Signals: watch_start/stop/poll (signal event log). UI: find_ui_elements/click_button (UI element discovery + button clicks).

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

port.description: game_bridge_install: desired starting listen port (the actual port starts at the game-side env GODOT_MCP_BRIDGE_PORT and increments when taken; this parameter changes nothing and is kept for compatibility). The actual port is in the ping response and the instance registry

source_script_path.description: install_override/uninstall_override: absolute path of the debug script (must be inside the ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS whitelist; copied to the project root and registered as the MCPOVERRIDE_<basename> autoload, appended at the end of [autoload] = loads after the game's autoloads, so its _ready can use game singletons directly without await <Singleton>.ready)

method.description: Method for game_query/game_write/game_input/game_wait/game_playtest. game_query: ping, get_tree, find_nodes (a root param limits the search to a subtree, absolute paths like /root/Main recommended; a missing node is an error, not a silent whole-tree search), get_node_properties, get_node_layout, get_performance, get_viewport_info, take_screenshot, get_errors (game runtime errors; since_seq for increments + clear to read-and-clear), clear_errors (empty the error buffer). game_write: set_node_property, call_method (coroutine methods are fire-and-forget by default and return a {coroutine:true} marker + note; pass params.await_completion=true to wait for the return value via a deferred response, raise timeout for long coroutines). game_input: send_key, send_mouse_click (button: int 1-9/left/right/middle), send_mouse_move, send_text, send_touch, send_drag, send_input_sequence (frame-timed timeline, deferred response). game_wait: wait_for_node, wait_for_property. game_playtest: playtest.seed (locks the global RNG, covers randi/randf only), playtest.fixed_delta (locks the physics step, delta=1/hz), playtest.step (advance N frames, deferred coroutine response), playtest.snapshot (snapshot scene tree properties; signals/physics/freed nodes are not kept), playtest.restore (restore properties from the snapshot). G1 control layer: playtest.freeze (sets tree.paused), playtest.unfreeze, playtest.step_until (advance until conditions hold / frames run out / wall timeout; structured conditions {path,property,op,value}[] ANDed, no Expression)

params.description: Method arguments. game_query: depends on the method. get_errors {since_seq?:int (default 0, only seq>since_seq), clear?:bool (default false, empty the buffer after reading)}. game_write: set_node_property {path, property, value}, call_method {path, method, args}. call_method defaults to a read-only whitelist (get/has_*/get_meta etc.); env GODOT_MCP_BRIDGE_EXTRA_METHODS=method1,method2 extends it (including write methods like take_damage); EXTRA_METHODS_BLOCKLIST (free/queue_free/set_script/call/emit_signal etc.) is a hard floor that cannot be overridden. args are coerced to the declared parameter types ([1,2,3] becomes a Vector3). Unknown methods get did-you-mean suggestions. The response carries undoable=false (calls cannot be undone). game_input: send_key {key, pressed}, send_mouse_click {x, y, button, pressed}, send_mouse_move {x, y}, send_text {text}, send_touch {x, y, pressed, index}, send_drag {x, y, index, relative, speed}, send_input_sequence {timeline:[{at_frame:1-600 (Nth frame after the window opens),type:action|key|mouse_click|mouse_move|touch|drag,...event params}], settle_frames?:int(0-600), wall_budget_ms?:int(1000-50000), ≤256 events} (action fields name/pressed/strength?, other types use the same fields as their send_*; when frozen it opens a window to play and refreezes after). game_wait: wait_for_node {path}, wait_for_property {path, property, value}. game_playtest: playtest.seed {seed:int}, playtest.fixed_delta {hz:int}, playtest.step {frames:int(1-60)}, playtest.snapshot/restore take no params. G1 control: playtest.freeze/unfreeze take no params, playtest.step_until {conditions:[{path:String,property:String,op:String(==/!=/</>/<=/>=),value:scalar/geometry}], max_frames?:int(1-600, default 600), wall_budget_ms?:int(1000-50000, default 30000)}

timeout.description: game_query/game_write/game_input/game_wait: timeout in ms (default 10000). For game_wait it is the budget of the whole polling window (probes repeatedly until the condition holds). send_input_sequence responds late; its timeout widens to wall_budget+10s automatically (max 65000)

interval_ms.description: game_wait only: polling interval in ms (default 200, range 50-2000). Applies to wait_for_node/wait_for_property only

interval_frames.description: monitor_start: sampling interval in frames (default 10, min 1, max 300)

signal_name.description: watch_start: signal name to listen for (e.g. "pressed", "health_changed")

max_events.description: watch_start: max events to record (default 1000, max 5000)

push.description: P3-6 watch_start/monitor_start: push mode (sends an MCP notification on each event/sample, no polling). The client must subscribe via resources/subscribe to receive them

pattern.description: find_ui_elements: name/text match pattern (Godot match syntax)

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

Proxy tool for calling advanced/deactivated Godot tools. Call with { tool_name: "<name>", arguments: {...} }.

All tools are currently directly available — no proxy needed.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the target tool

tools.name: godot_get_context

project_path.description: Project path (alternative; instance_id wins)

tools.name: help
tools.description: Full documentation for any tool. Available tool names: analysis, android, animation, animation_track, animtree, asset, audio, audit, blender, cpp, csv_to_resources, debug, docs, editor, engine, game, godot_advanced_tool, godot_get_context, godot_list_dynamic_routes, godot_list_instances, godot_select_instance, help, load_skill, manage_tools, material, nav, particles, physics, profiler, project, qa, runtime, runtime_assert, scene, screenshot, script, self_update, signal, testing, tilemap, translation, ui, uid, validation, workflow. Pass tool_name for that tool's detailed usage, parameters and action list. Misspellings get the closest tool name suggested.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Search SKILL.md files in local knowledge bases (GodotPrompter/gd-agentic etc.) by keyword. Two-level search: high-precision name/description first, full-text fallback. Returns matches with source labels (source/path) and a relevance score. Missing libraries go to missing_libraries instead of failing.

Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

target_fps.description: Target FPS for frame budget analysis (get_data, default 60)

dimensions.description: Sampling dimensions (get_data, default ["process"]). Valid: process, physics, nav_process

leak_threshold_mb.description: Suspected memory leak threshold in MB (get_data, default 2.0)

node_path.description: Subtree root node path (get_active_processes/get_signal_connections, default root)

tools.name: project
tools.description: Find Godot projects, get project info, list files, read config, create a project, set up project rules.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

hooks.description: Create the PostToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json (default true)

rules_mode.description: Rule file reconcile mode: check (default, report only) / update (overwrite outdated files the user hasn't touched, keep touched ones) / overwrite (overwrite everything, including local changes)

agents_md.description: Create/append AGENTS.md project rules (read by clients following the AGENTS.md standard such as ZCode/Codex/Cursor; default true)

ci.description: Generate a GitHub Actions CI workflow (default false)

tools.name: qa
tools.description: QA test suite orchestration: structured test spec → auto-install the bridge → run the game → execute step by step → aggregated report + regression diff. Step types: input/wait/wait_frames/freeze/unfreeze/step_until/snapshot/restore/set/call/ watch_start|stop/monitor_start|stop/assert/screenshot/sleep; the 8 assertion kinds and each field's meaning are in the schema field descriptions. run supports mode:async for background runs (managed with qa status/cancel). Reports go to ~/.godot-mcp/qa-reports/<run_id>.{json,md}.

action.description: run = run a suite; report = read a report; diff = compare two reports for regressions; status = run registry (progress/final state); cancel = cancel a run in progress

mode.description: run: sync = wait for the full result; async = return run_id immediately and run in the background (poll with qa status, cancel with qa cancel). Default when unspecified: async if the client declares the MCP tasks capability, otherwise sync

run_id.description: status/cancel: target run_id (omitted for status = list all registered runs)

spec.description: run: inline suite spec object. Steps are a discriminated union (the type field decides the shape): input (method+params, native bridge params), wait (polls wait_for_node/wait_for_property), wait_frames (deterministic 1-60 frame advance), freeze/unfreeze, step_until (structured conditions {path,property,op,value}[], avoids RCE), snapshot/restore, set (write node properties), call (bridge read-only whitelist; write methods need GODOT_MCP_BRIDGE_EXTRA_METHODS), watch_start (node_path+signal_name, one watch per suite), watch_stop, monitor_start (node_path+properties[], one monitor per suite), monitor_stop, screenshot (evidence saved to the report directory), sleep. Give steps a label so diffs line up

spec_path.description: run: spec file path (.json, or .md with a ```qa-spec fence); use a file for big suites to avoid token truncation; must be inside the ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS whitelist

project_path.description: run: project path (overrides project_path in the spec; required if the spec has none)

report_path.description: report: report path or run_id; latest = newest, prev = second newest

tools.name: runtime
tools.description: Launch the editor, run/stop the project, get debug output, run tests, get the Godot version.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

timeout.description: Auto-stop after N seconds (default 30; pass more, e.g. 120, for games with a >30s cold start; with wait_for_bridge it becomes max(bridge_timeout+10, timeout) to avoid racing bridge readiness)

wait_for_bridge.description: When true, poll for bridge readiness after spawning (default false, backwards compatible)

bridge_timeout.description: Total polling budget for wait_for_bridge (seconds, default 10)

test_script.description: Test script or directory path (default res://test/)

quit_flag.description: GUT quit flag for run_tests. Default gquit (GUT ≤9.5); switch to gexit when GUT 9.6+ dropped -gquit (it reports Unknown arguments: -gquit)

events_json.description: Recording: event sequence as a JSON string

file_name.description: Recording save: always auto-named recording_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss.json (the file_name input is ignored), but file_name must still match recording_*.json (otherwise INVALID_FILE_NAME) and must not contain / \\ ..

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

tools.name: runtime_assert
tools.description: Runtime assertions: check node state / scene structure / on-screen text / performance / screenshot diff in the running game. The agent can call it at any time without going through workflow.dev_loop. Everything needs the game bridge (game_bridge_install first + game running).

project_path.description: Project path (required for screenshot_diff: resolves where user:// screenshots land)

absent.description: true = assert the node does not exist

present.description: screen_text: true = assert the text is present (default), false = assert it is absent

reference.description: screenshot_diff: reference screenshot path (res://, project-relative or absolute; must be whitelisted)

threshold.description: screenshot_diff: per-pixel difference threshold (0-1, default 0.12). A pixel counts as different only when its normalised RGB distance is strictly greater; smaller is stricter

max_diff_ratio.description: screenshot_diff: max share of differing pixels (0-1, default 0.05). Pass 0 for strict pixel regression; for ordinary visual regression calibrate against a known-good pair with the same layout (measured ≈0.176 for such a pair in this repo, don't go below that order)

tools.name: scene
tools.description: Scene operations. Read/create: read_scene, create_scene, quick_scene. Nodes: add_node, batch_add_nodes, edit_node, remove_node. Save/resources: save_scene, load_sprite. Query: query_scene_tree, inspect_node. Instances: instance_scene, set_instance_property, detach_instance.

project_path.description: Godot project directory

scene_path.description: Scene path (absolute for read_scene, project-relative for everything else)

summary_only.description: read_scene: return a summary instead of the full JSON

root_node_name.description: quick_scene: root node name (default: PascalCase of the file name)

script_content.description: quick_scene: script content (the script is created if missing)

new_path.description: save_scene: new save path (optional) / merge_scene: path of the theirs scene (required)

operations.description: commit: list of batch operations (enum in the op field; painting / TileSet layer config / nodes)

tileset_path.description: TileSet .tres path (the 9 layer-config ops accept res:// inside the project only)

shape.description: rect = the whole cell's four corners; polygon = custom points

points.description: Polygon points [{x,y}] (omit for rect; each checked at runtime)

name.description: Node name (node_add) / data layer name (cdata add)

value.description: Property value (node_property) / data value (cdata set, must match the layer type)

stop_on_error.description: Stop on error (default true; with false a failure doesn't block later ops or writing the .tres)

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot capture and image analysis handoff. capture: capture a Godot scene screenshot in headless mode (experimental). analyze: return the image as MCP image content (base64) for the client vision capability to examine — returns image data, NOT a text description.

project_path.description: Path to Godot project directory

action.description: Action type: capture (take a screenshot), analyze (AI visual analysis of an image), or diff (pixel-level comparison of two PNG images)

scene.description: capture: Scene file path relative to project (res://scenes/main.tscn). If omitted, captures the default scene or an empty viewport.

output_path.description: capture: Output PNG path (absolute). Defaults to <project_path>/screenshot.png

frame_delay.description: capture: Frames to wait before capture (default: 15)

wait_node.description: capture: wait for this node (name or /root/... path) to appear in the scene tree before capturing. For scenes built over several frames or initialised asynchronously; takes precedence over frame_delay; on timeout (fixed 300 frames ≈5s@60fps, independent of max_frames) captures anyway

wait_text.description: capture: wait until some Label/RichTextLabel's text contains this substring before capturing; same timeout as wait_node (fixed 300 frames ≈5s@60fps, independent of max_frames)

image_path.description: analyze: Absolute path to the image file (PNG or JPG)

question.description: analyze: Question for the AI to answer about the image. Default: "Describe what you see in this game screenshot."
question.default: Describe what you see in this game screenshot. Focus on: UI elements, character positions, any visual issues or bugs.

vision_route.description: Phase 2 Vision Routing: when on, a vision model (groq) turns the image into a text description and returns plain text (no image block), so text-only models (DeepSeek etc.) can "see" screenshots. On failure falls back to the detail levels + a note. Needs the GODOT_MCP_VISION_KEY env var.

vision_question.description: Context passed to the vision model when vision_route=true (optional, e.g. "I'm debugging the Player walk animation").

detail.description: P1-5 vision cost level: full (full base64 image, many tokens) / thumbnail (PNG scaled to thumbnail_width, medium) / ascii (ASCII art text, few tokens). Default full.

thumbnail_width.description: detail=thumbnail: target width in pixels (default 256, keeps aspect ratio)

image_a.description: diff: baseline image (a) path. Relative paths need project_path; both images must be the same size.

image_b.description: diff: comparison image (b) path. Same path policy as analyze's image_path (whitelist check).

threshold.description: diff: per-pixel normalised Euclidean distance threshold sqrt(Δr²+Δg²+Δb²)/(√3×255), 0-1, default 0.12. Exactly equal doesn't count (strictly greater only). Alpha ignored, RGB only.

diff_path.description: diff: optional output path for a diff image. Differing pixels are painted pure red (255,0,0), the rest keep image a's colours. Nothing is written when omitted.

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

tools.name: script
tools.description: Script operations. Read/write: read_script, write_script. Edit: edit_script (line numbers / search_and_replace). Execute: execute_gdscript (⚠️ the sandbox only guards against mistakes, not untrusted input; for high-security setups use ALLOW_EXECUTE_GDSCRIPT=false or container isolation). ⚠️ write_script/edit_script also sandbox-scan .gd content before writing (against @tool scripts that run on load and other known dangerous API patterns (list not published so the boundary can't be probed); same threat surface as execute_gdscript). Tests: generate_test, create_test_scene. Bulk replace: project_replace. 💡 execute_gdscript best practice: run in small steps and verify each (split complex logic into small pieces, iterate with read_script/edit_script, avoid one big script whose failure is hard to locate).

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

script_path.description: Absolute path for read_script; absolute or project-relative for write_script/edit_script/generate_test

overwrite.description: write_script: overwrite an existing file (default false)

end_line.description: edit_script: last line to replace (1-based, inclusive)

auto_validate.description: edit_script: validate syntax automatically and roll back on failure (default true)

search_and_replace.description: edit_script: search-and-replace mode (start_line/end_line are ignored when given)

load_autoloads.description: execute_gdscript: autoload references are auto-detected when omitted; explicit true/false overrides detection

dry_run.description: project_replace: preview only, write nothing (default false)

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

tools.name: self_update
tools.description: Check/update enhanced itself. check: latest npm version + addon version drift per project (read-only). update: update a project's addon to the package version (overwrite install, needs confirmation).

action.description: check = version status (read-only) / update = update the project addon (destructive, needs confirmation)

project_path.description: Target Godot project path (required for update; optional for check, defaults to scanning everything in ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS)

tools.name: signal
tools.description: Signal operations. connect/disconnect: connect/disconnect a signal. emit: emit a signal (primitive arguments only). list: list a node's signals. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

tools.name: testing
tools.description: McpTestSuite test framework (editor-only): runs GDScript test suites written by the AI (`extends McpTestSuite`, placed in `res://tests/` or `addons/godot_mcp_server/testing/suites/`). run: discover and run suites; returns structured passed/failed/skipped/total/failures. manage: op="results_get" fetches the partial results of the last run (after a timeout/interruption). ⚠️ P2-12 phase 2: runs as an async coroutine, yielding the main loop after each test (heartbeat keeps pinging), so long suites work (total budget 290s; on timeout split the run with suite=). ⚠️ editor-only: headless mode returns EDITOR_ONLY. Needs `GODOT_MCP_MODE=editor` and the Godot plugin installed.

suite.description: run: suite name filter (exact match on suite_name(), empty = all)

test_name.description: run: test method name filter (substring, empty = all)

verbose.description: run/manage: return per-test details (default: aggregate + failures only)

project_path.description: Path to Godot project directory (can be omitted in editor mode to use the open project)

tools.name: tilemap
tools.description: TileMap/TileMapLayer cell operations. Read: tilemap_read, tilemap_copy. Write: tilemap_set_cell, tilemap_erase_cell, tilemap_fill_rect, tilemap_clear, tilemap_paste, tilemap_set_transform. Pass scene_path to work on any scene, otherwise the main scene is used. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

node_path.description: TileMap/TileMapLayer node path (e.g. root/Level/TileMap); with scene_path it resolves relative to that scene, and the root/ prefix and scene root name can be omitted

scene_path.description: Target scene path (project-relative, optional). When omitted, application/run/main_scene is loaded — if the main scene is a menu without a TileMap you get TILEMAP_NOT_FOUND

layer.description: Layer index (optional, default 0). Used by tilemap_read/set_cell/erase_cell/fill_rect/copy/paste/set_transform; tilemap_clear without it clears every layer

region.description: Rect2i area. tilemap_read: area to read (optional, default all used cells); tilemap_fill_rect: area to fill

coords.description: Cell coordinates Vector2i. Used by tilemap_set_cell/erase_cell/set_transform

source_id.description: TileSet source ID. Used by tilemap_set_cell/fill_rect

atlas_coords.description: Atlas coordinates Vector2i. Used by tilemap_set_cell/fill_rect

alternative_tile.description: Alternative tile index (optional, default 0). Used by tilemap_set_cell/fill_rect

target.description: Paste target Vector2i. Used by tilemap_paste

pattern.description: Tile pattern (the pattern object returned by tilemap_copy). Used by tilemap_paste

flip_h.description: Flip horizontally (optional, default false). Used by tilemap_set_transform

flip_v.description: Flip vertically (optional, default false). Used by tilemap_set_transform

transpose.description: Transpose (optional, default false). Used by tilemap_set_transform

tools.name: translation
tools.description: Translation files. read: read CSV/PO translation entries (languages/key-values). write: write/create a Godot-compatible CSV translation table (key + one column per language; CSV→.translation compilation is done by the editor import). register: register .translation/.po files in project.godot (translations array; remove=true removes them).

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

path.description: read/write: translation file path (res://-relative; read supports .csv/.po, write .csv only)

languages.description: write: language codes (e.g. [en, zh_CN], matching the entries keys)

remove.description: register: true = remove from the registry (default false = register)

limit.description: read: max entries returned (default 200, keeps big files from flooding the context)

tools.name: ui
tools.description: UI operations. Nodes: ui_create_control, ui_container_add, ui_build_layout. Layout: ui_set_layout, ui_get_layout, ui_anchor_preset. Prototype: ui_import_prototype (geometry JSON → translate + build + measure + check + persist in one call; bg/fill/borderRadius/border→StyleBoxFlat saved as theme_override_styles/<slot>; returns style_verify per-slot style diff / flow_verify rect diff of a flow's direct children). Final pixel check: ui_pixel_verify (samples bg node screenshots vs target colour RGB distance; opens a window on Windows; run once after geometry + style_verify are all green). Theme: ui_set_theme, theme_create, theme_set_property. Drawing: ui_draw_recipe. Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file. Extra params (additionalProperties): ui_set_theme→theme_action/theme_path/params; theme_create→theme_create_action/source_node_path/save_path; theme_set_property→theme_node_path/item_type/prop_name/theme_type/value; ui_build_layout→tree({type,name,properties,anchor_preset,layout,flex,children}); ui_draw_recipe→ops([{kind,...}]); ui_measure_layout→node_path(optional, default whole scene)/max_depth; ui_import_prototype→geometry({viewport,nodes} inline JSON, or geometry_path; bg/fill/borderRadius/border→StyleBoxFlat)/geometry_path(geometry JSON file path, res:// supported)/tolerance(default 2) → returns style_verify/flow_verify; ui_pixel_verify→geometry/geometry_path+scene_path(required, an already built scene; samples bg node screenshots vs target colour, opens a window on Windows; final check — run once after geometry + style_verify are all green)

project_path.description: Godot project directory

scene_path.description: Scene path (project-relative). Optional for ui_set_theme/theme_set_property; required for ui_pixel_verify — an already built scene (the output of ui_import_prototype persist)

anchors.description: ui_set_layout: anchors {left, right, top, bottom}, values 0-1

offsets.description: ui_set_layout: offsets {left, right, top, bottom} in pixels

expect_tree.description: ui_measure_layout: optional target tree (same as the ui_build_layout tree, with rects); when given, outputs per-node diffs / overlaps / out-of-bounds

parent_path.description: ui_build_layout: parent node path; ui_import_prototype: must be a node aligned to the origin (global_position≈0,0), default root — when mounted elsewhere, layout_verify solves root-level entries against the viewport origin and root-level diffs are always false alarms

viewport.description: ui_build_layout: reference size {w, h} for solving the root rect (default 1280x720, must be positive; when it matches the project's display/window/size the root rect is the viewport's absolute geometry); ui_import_prototype: optional, defaults to geometry.viewport

persist.description: ui_build_layout: persist to .tscn (atomic write; default false = runtime only)

tools.name: uid
tools.description: File UID management (Godot 4.4+). scan: find resources missing .uid and orphan .uid files. get: look up file UIDs (batch). set: write .uid (a given uid / generate for one file / fix_missing in batch). check_refs: detect dangling uid:// references (checked against the project's .uid set only; a reference whose uid dangles but whose ext_resource has a path fallback still loads fine — it is counted as dangling as a diagnostic hint, not a broken link). Runtime operation, affects only the current execution context. To persist, edit the .tscn file.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

uid.description: set: explicit UID text (uid://xxxx); when omitted it is generated deterministically from the path (same as the editor)

fix_missing.description: set: fix every resource missing a .uid in one go

extensions.description: Resource extensions covered by scan/set (lowercase, default 26 common types)

limit.description: Max detail entries for scan/check_refs (default 100, max 500)

tools.name: validation
tools.description: Run verification, analyse errors, validate the project/scripts, import resources. One-shot headless run + error analysis, or individual checks on demand.

project_path.description: Godot project directory (optional; defaults to the GODOT_PROJECT_PATH env var or the current directory)

scope.description: Verification scope (required for verify_delivery): scene/script/full. Ignored by other actions

capture_tree.description: Also capture a scene tree snapshot (default false)

check_resources.description: Check for missing resource files (default true)

check_scripts.description: Check for broken script references (default true)

exclude_paths.description: Excluded directories (relative to the project root). Default: .godot, .import

scripts.description: Script paths to validate (project-relative). When omitted, all .gd files are scanned

extensions.description: File extensions to import (default: common image/audio/font types)

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)

tools.name: workflow
tools.description: Development workflow tools. dev_loop: execute GDScript with optional validation, bridge queries, and state saving. scene_snapshot: capture structured scene tree snapshot. batch_validate: validate multiple GDScript files at once.

project_path.description: Path to Godot project directory

code.description: dev_loop: GDScript code to execute (snippet or full extends SceneTree)

verify.description: dev_loop: Also run project validation after execution (default: false)

timeout.description: dev_loop: Timeout per step in seconds (default: 30)

bridge.description: dev_loop: Optional Game Bridge for screenshot/query validation

screenshot.description: Take a screenshot from the running game

path.description: Screenshot save path in game (default: user://mcp_dev_screenshot.png)

queries.description: Bridge queries to run after code execution (max 10)

assertions.description: Array of assertions to run after code execution

gdscript.description: GDScript code using _mcp_output to output results

type.description: Assertion type: gdscript (default), screenshot_diff, or frame_degradation

expect_present.description: screenshot_diff: node names expected to be visible in scene tree

reference_path.description: screenshot_diff: optional reference image path for cosine-similarity pre-filter

frames_dir.description: frame_degradation: directory of captured frames (omit if acceptance.frame_sequence captures them)

frame_sequence.description: Capture N frames into a proof dir before assertions run; frames feed frame_degradation assertions

count.description: Number of frames to capture (2-60, default 12)

save_state.description: dev_loop: Save session state to file

path.description: State file path relative to project (default: production/session-state/active.md)

files_modified.description: List of files modified in this session

scene_path.description: scene_snapshot: Scene file path relative to project

scripts.description: batch_validate: Array of script paths relative to project

godot_path.description: Override the Godot binary path (optional; takes precedence over project config and env vars)
